edits.content:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}
select customer_id, country_code, signup_date from {{ source('demo', 'customers') }}

{{ config(materialized='view') }}
select order_id, customer_id, status, order_total, cast(placed_at as timestamp) as ordered_at from {{ source('demo', 'orders') }}

{{ config(materialized='view') }}
select o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.status, o.order_total, o.ordered_at, c.country_code
from {{ ref('stg_orders') }} o
left join {{ ref('stg_customers') }} c on o.customer_id = c.customer_id

{{ config(materialized='table') }}
with orders as (
 select customer_id, count(*) as order_count, sum(order_total) as booked_amount
 from {{ ref('stg_orders') }} group by customer_id
)
select c.customer_id, c.country_code, c.signup_date,
 coalesce(o.order_count, cast(0 as bigint)) as order_count,
 coalesce(o.booked_amount, cast(0 as decimal(38,2))) as booked_amount
from {{ ref('stg_customers') }} c
left join orders o on c.customer_id = o.customer_id
